name: HAMi
readme_excerpt: English version | 中文版 | 日本語版 HAMi Kubernetes GPU virtualization and heterogeneous accelerator scheduling for AI infrastructure. HAMi stands for Heterogeneous AI Computing Virtualization Middleware. Formerly known as k8s-vGPU-scheduler, HAMi helps platform teams share expensive GPUs and other AI accelerators across Kubernetes workloads, isolate device memory and compute, and schedule pods with device-aware policies without changing application code.
